meta.title: feat: conditionally import fonts only when custom font family is not provided
meta.body_summary: Conditionally import Google Fonts (Inter) and KHTeka font-face declarations only when no custom font family is provided via --w3m-font-family CSS variable, to skip unnecessary network requests.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added conditional font imports but had a logic bug with empty string handling; cursor bot flagged the bug three times; PR closed without merge after tests were added but bug left unresolved.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The large change scale (4174 lines, 196 files) is mostly from a merge commit pulling in unrelated main changes; the actual perf-related change is a small front-end optimization. The closure was due to an unresolved correctness bug, not the size.

review_details.concern_detail: The conditional import logic uses a truthiness check on the CSS variable, which fails when it is an empty string (falsy), causing default fonts to be loaded contrary to test expectations.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid unnecessary font downloads when a custom font family is provided, reducing network requests and improving load performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: No human approval after bug discovery; cursor bot repeatedly flagged the empty-string bug; PR left in limbo and eventually closed without a fix.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The Agent struggled with a subtle JavaScript truthiness edge case (empty string evaluated as false), leading to an incorrect conditional check that persisted despite added tests; this is a low-level front-end logic gap.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor bot performed static analysis and identified the empty-string bug in the conditional expression; no manual performance testing or benchmarking was requested or provided.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance data, profiling, or benchmark was included; only narrative claims in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After the bug was flagged multiple times and never addressed, the PR remained open for over a month and was eventually closed by inactivity or bot action; no revert or fix-in-pr occurred.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/ui and packages/ui-new, wrapping existing font import/CSS declarations with a conditional that checks if --w3m-font-family is set in themeVariables; if set, an empty CSS template is used, otherwise default fonts (Inter via Google Fonts and KHTeka font-face) are included.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Tests were added to verify the conditional behavior, but they did not catch the empty-string edge case that was later reported by the cursor bot.
